variants.headline: Still in view: party walks out of government
variants.sub: A governing party has left the colony's government.
variants.body:
Coverage continues after {months_running} months; this is a continuing story rather than a fresh announcement. A party has walked out of the government in {colony}.

The conduct of {target} should be examined in the light of the departure itself. This paper does not attribute an unreported motive to the break or announce an unreported governmental outcome.

variants.headline: Still in view: a governing partnership breaks
variants.sub: The government has lost a party from its governing arrangement.
variants.body:
This story remains under examination, {months_running} months into our coverage of the original event. A governing party has left the colony's government.

The conduct of {target} should be examined in the light of the departure itself. This paper does not attribute an unreported motive to the break or announce an unreported governmental outcome.

variants.headline: Still in view: departure redraws the question of cooperation
variants.sub: A party has walked out of the government in {colony}.
variants.body:
Our attention to this story continues after {months_running} months, with the original report still the starting point. The government has lost a party from its governing arrangement.

The conduct of {target} should be examined in the light of the departure itself. This paper does not attribute an unreported motive to the break or announce an unreported governmental outcome.
